summary: Iteration 2 full stack testing complete. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass covering Voice transcription (silent WAV → 200 with text field), Connectors CRUD (create REST → list → test with field_map returning {sku,name} sample rows → delete), role guards (worker 403, manager 403 on POST /api/connectors — org_admin only), multi-tenant isolation (new signup org sees empty connectors), Approval workflow (worker delta<=50 direct-applies, delta>50 creates pending approval without mutating inventory, GET /api/approvals?status_filter=pending lists it, approve actually mutates inventory qty, reject leaves inventory unchanged), Barcode/QR PDF labels (application/pdf mime, %PDF header, 401 without token). Frontend: admin login → /app/connectors (New connector dialog opens, REST fields visible, save/list/test/delete work), /app/approvals loads, /app/ai has ai-mic-btn next to send button (click does not throw console errors in headless), /app/products/{id} detail page shows print-barcode-btn and print-qr-btn — both clickable with no console errors. Fixed one production bug during test: POST /api/users returned raw dict containing mongo _id (ObjectId), causing 500 on serialization when creating a fresh user; excluded _id from response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >850 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, products, inventory, approvals, connectors, ai, labels, voice) for maintainability.

Fixed: POST /api/users response included MongoDB _id (ObjectId) causing 500 on serialization; now excluded. Recommend applying the same pattern proactively to other insert-then-return endpoints (e.g., signup, warehouses, locations, products, inventory, connectors) — currently they work because response dicts are constructed before insert_one, but insert_one MUTATES the passed dict adding _id. Any future refactor that returns the same dict variable could break. Prefer building a response dict from the payload rather than the pre-inserted document.
connector_fetch uses blocking ext_requests.get and sqlalchemy sync engine inside an async endpoint — will block the event loop under load. Consider httpx.AsyncClient / asyncio.to_thread.
list_connectors masks password/auth_value in response but the mutation is done in-place on the DB-fetched dict; safe here since motor returns a fresh dict per call, but worth a comment.
